claim_updates.reason: No change from the pre-experiment registry ceiling (research/claims/registry.json: C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE status HYPOTHESIS, owner_lanes graph/product/frontier, next_gate 'unseen-goal resolution with applicability/abstention calibration'). The producer reported status=COMPLETE outcome=FALSIFIES and provenance.json validity.claim_update_authorized=true, and the independent audit (audit.json status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, producer_claim_supported=false) rejects that ceiling, so the pre-declared falsifier in spec.json.falsifier and prereg.md section 3 was NOT validly triggered and no architectural component is retired. Four independent defects each remove the falsifier's force. (1) Construct validity: the frozen primary metric does not measure the frozen construct - artifacts/experiment_runner.py:376-390 derives `correct` from the HTTP status implied by the bound method and never consults mechanism postconditions, and the audit cross-tabulation of all 300 raw rows shows `correct` is a deterministic function of which mechanism was selected (create-a-new-user 33/33, list-photos 32/32, update-a-comment 0/91, retrieve-a-post-by-id 0/35, delete-an-album 0/48); of the candidate's 59 EXECUTABLE rows, 57 bound the family-correct mechanism and 33 of those were scored incorrect purely because their templates carry unbindable ${...} placeholders, so false_accept_rate 0.5932 is a fixture-executability artifact. (2) Identifiability: the comparison arm is empty by construction, not by measurement - the auditor's independent probe of src/spider/kernel.py:74-123 (which I read and confirm: distill emits confidence=0.5 with parameter_slots=[], resolve returns EXPLORE below min_confidence and EXECUTABLE only at min_confidence<=0.5) against the frozen min_confidence=0.8 makes A-INCUMBENT's 0.000 a code certainty, so primary gate condition 1 is satisfied by any arm emitting one EXECUTABLE decision; this reproduces the C_i == C_c degeneracy the Codex recorded for EXP-FRONTIER-36249071934 by a different method. (3) The calibration half of the gate was fixed before any arm ran: prereg.md section 6 item 3 froze a learned logistic calibration head, artifacts/candidate_resolver.py:148 implements an untrained fixed sigmoid 1/(1+exp(-10*(cos-0.3))), so the frozen threshold 0.5 is algebraically cosine>=0.3 and only 1 of 60 tasks fell below it; separately the half-open top ECE bin at artifacts/experiment_runner.py:489-493 silently discarded all 60 p_applicable=1.0 rows of two null arms and reported ece_global 0.0000 where closed-top-bin recomputation gives 0.7500 (B-RANDOM-ROLE) and 0.8333 (B-INTERNAL-ID-LOOKUP). (4) The fixture cannot discriminate the claim: the audit's AUDIT-DERIVED mechanism-identity counts, which I recomputed and confirm from raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl, put A-CANDIDATE at 20/20 and B-LEXICAL-OVERLAP at 20/20 on the 20 unseen paraphrased goals and 58/60 versus 49/60 over all 60, so max-token-Jaccard already reaches ceiling on the very comparison prereg.md section 9 gates 6-7 exist to make. Two further gate failures compound this: PC-EXACT-MATCH has zero trials (0 of 60 goals are verbatim intents, verified in raw_evidence/goal_generation.json; the computation is guarded by `if inc_verbatim:` and never fires, and the producer's '0/12 verbatim tasks' denominator exists in no artifact, so the correct encoding is null / NOT MEASURED), and both recorded secondary-gate passes had no test computed behind them (audit recomputation on the producer's own counts fails both: two-proportion p=0.0794 and 0.1213, exact McNemar p=0.1078 and 0.0078, family-blocked bootstrap 95% CIs [-0.2333, 0.5667] and [0.0000, 0.3333]). The packet's own frozen mapping was overridden ex post: spec.json.decision_rule.outcomes.MEASUREMENT_INVALID and prereg.md 8.1/8.2/9 name PC and NC failure as MEASUREMENT_INVALID, both are recorded pass=false, and artifacts/experiment_runner.py:780-784 contains no MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch. Two narrowly-bounded new observations are attached to the unchanged hypothesis: the committed SpiderKernel cannot reach EXECUTABLE after its own distill at min_confidence 0.8 (independently re-probed by the auditor), and on this 5-mechanism, one-per-family fixture goal-to-mechanism selection is trivially achievable by lexical overlap, so the semantic-versus-lexical question and the applicability-calibration question are both still untested. prereg.md section 14's MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch applies: it does not update claim status, it records the validity threat and the smallest next action, which is the re-freeze specified in next_question.

No change from the pre-experiment registry ceiling (research/claims/registry.json: C-PARAM-INHERIT status EXPERIMENTAL, next_gate 'learn on resource A, succeed on never-observed B against cold/replay/retrieval baselines'); this event records a dependency fact for Product, not a claim update. The independent audit re-probed src/spider/kernel.py at this experiment's executing commit and confirmed shipped_has_distill_parameterized=false, distill emitting confidence 0.5 with parameter_slots=[] and applicability_guards={}, and EXECUTABLE reachable only at min_confidence<=0.5; that is consistent with the Global Research Director's portfolio assessment that 'def distill_parameterized' is absent from src/ on origin/main and the six current lane heads and with the Codex-recorded EXP-FRONTIER-36249071934 probe. The consequence for this packet is concrete: because every mechanism in the frozen fixture had parameter_slots=[], four of five action templates were structurally unbindable and the per-task context target ids injected by artifacts/experiment_runner.py:348-351 reached no arm (0 bindings), which is the direct cause of the VF-01 metric confound. Scope is deliberately narrow: the probe covers the kernel at this commit, and whether a parameterized induction path exists anywhere in the current tree is outside this packet and outside the audit's mandate (audit unresolved 8), so this event must not be read as a new rejection, a narrowing, or a license to treat the claim's existing bounded ceiling as reduced.

product_action: NO_PROMOTION and NO_RETIREMENT. Nothing from this packet may enter Product Core, and nothing from it licenses retiring semantic resolution as an architectural component. There is no audited valid measurement of goal-to-mechanism resolution here: the only promotable-looking artifact is a research-harness resolver at artifacts/candidate_resolver.py that is not bound to the freeze (its mtime postdates freeze.json and its hash appears only in producer-authored result.json.artifacts), was never evaluated against an identified comparison, and whose reported false-accept 0.5932 and ECE 0.5197 are fixture artifacts that must not be read as economics, latency or amortization. Product must not be moved onto explicit goal annotation or full re-exploration on this basis, and the report's claim that C-LLM-INHERIT, C-CROSSSITE and C-PRODUCT-ECON are blocked by this gate is not authorized: the gate was never validly evaluated, so those dependencies are unchanged rather than tightened. The single product-relevant fact this packet does establish is a negative capability fact, independently re-confirmed here and already recorded in the mandate: the committed kernel at the executing commit cannot return EXECUTABLE after its own distill, so any product claim that assumes inherited mechanisms actually execute must be costed against a kernel that abstains.

reason: Adjudicated against the frozen packet and the independent audit, not against the producer's outcome label. result.json reports status=COMPLETE, outcome=FALSIFIES and provenance.json validity.claim_update_authorized=true; the audit reports status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID with producer_claim_supported=false and an explicit claim_ceiling that the producer's ceiling is not justified. Four independent defects each individually remove the falsifier's force, and the frozen document itself demanded MEASUREMENT_INVALID on this run. (1) The primary metric does not measure the frozen construct: `correct` is the HTTP status implied by the bound method, and the audit's 300-row cross-tabulation shows it is a deterministic function of which mechanism was selected, so 33 of the candidate's 57 family-correct bindings were scored incorrect solely because three templates carry unbindable ${...} placeholders. (2) The comparison leg is empty by construction, not by measurement: distill emits confidence 0.5, EXECUTABLE requires min_confidence<=0.5, the frozen configuration was 0.8, so any arm emitting one EXECUTABLE decision satisfies primary condition 1 - the same self-fulfilling null the mandate's own first agent prior names and the Codex recorded for EXP-FRONTIER-36249071934. (3) The calibration gates were determined by construction before any arm ran: the frozen learned calibration head was implemented as an untrained fixed sigmoid whose threshold is algebraically cosine>=0.3 (1 of 60 tasks below it), and a half-open ECE bin dropped all 60 rows of two null arms, reporting perfect calibration for the two worst-calibrated arms in the packet. (4) The fixture does not discriminate the claim: the max-token-Jaccard null ties the candidate at 20/20 on the unseen paraphrased goals and reaches 49/60 overall, which I confirmed directly from raw_evidence/task_results.jsonl. The one control that would have exposed the broken pipeline - PC-EXACT-MATCH - was never executed, since no goal in the set is a verbatim intent; and the two recorded secondary-gate passes had no statistical test behind them and fail audit recomputation on the producer's own counts. The producer also substituted an OOD abstention rate for the preregistered UNKNOWN precision, declared a stopword-matching heuristic to be an internal-id oracle, and reported a diluted union-token overlap statistic in place of the preregistered per-goal independence criterion, whose declared smallest next action (regenerate with a new seed) was triggered at max 0.6667 and 38 of 60 goals above 0.3 and not executed. In fairness to the producer, the packet is honest: all nine artifact hashes match, all three frozen-input hashes match, no frozen file was modified after freeze, and every producer rate reproduces from raw evidence at four-decimal rounding - this is a well-transmitted execution of a defective design, not fabricated data, and the audit says so explicitly. The correct bounded decision is therefore MEASUREMENT_INVALID at packet level with C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE held at HYPOTHESIS, not a falsification and not a promotion. Graph is not parked: the claim is decidable and asset-free, the failure is packet construction rather than substrate or question, and a corrected design is a NEW experiment that requires a Global Research Director mandate under AGENTS.md and EXPERIMENT_PACKET.md section 2, so continue=false with a fully specified re-freeze target. Re-executing or lightly editing this design cannot help: the fixture shape, the primary metric definition, the unexecuted positive control, the vacuous oracle and the degenerate calibration gate are all inside the frozen inputs.
